basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old skincare enthusiast living in Toronto, Canada. I work as a freelance video editor, which gives me the flexibility to explore my passion for skincare routines and products. I spend a lot of my online time researching and discussing skincare trends, especially in the evenings after work. I'm currently single and enjoy engaging with communities that provide educational content and honest reviews. I'm skeptical about marketing buzzwords and prefer evidence-based skincare. My dislikes include overpriced products and misleading marketing, especially in the clean beauty space.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I developed my skincare knowledge through a combination of personal research and community interactions. I initially started with basic skincare routines and gradually moved to more complex regimens as I engaged with educational content on Reddit and YouTube. My editing work often requires me to stay updated with technology, which helps me easily navigate online platforms for research.
